metadata.title: Synthetic Training Manual: MUAC and Swelling Classifier

page_1.title: Purpose and inputs
page_1.raw_text:
Purpose and inputs

SYNTHETIC TRAINING ONLY. This is not clinical guidance.

For a synthetic child age 6 through 59 completed months, record mid-upper-arm circumference in millimetres and whether swelling of both feet is present.

Do not convert a value with an unknown or missing unit. Mark the assessment incomplete instead.

blocks.text: SYNTHETIC TRAINING ONLY. This is not clinical guidance.

page_2.title: Synthetic classification
page_2.raw_text:
Synthetic classification

Record SYNTHETIC_RED when bilateral foot swelling is present or MUAC is less than 115 millimetres.

Record SYNTHETIC_YELLOW when MUAC is 115 through 124 millimetres and bilateral foot swelling is absent.

Record SYNTHETIC_GREEN when MUAC is 125 millimetres or more and bilateral foot swelling is absent.

blocks.text: Record SYNTHETIC_RED when bilateral foot swelling is present or MUAC is less than 115 millimetres.
Record SYNTHETIC_YELLOW when MUAC is 115 through 124 millimetres and bilateral foot swelling is absent.
Record SYNTHETIC_GREEN when MUAC is 125 millimetres or more and bilateral foot swelling is absent.

page_3.title: Disposition
page_3.raw_text:
Disposition

SYNTHETIC_RED requests immediate facility review.

SYNTHETIC_YELLOW requests a nutrition-support capability lookup.

SYNTHETIC_GREEN records routine synthetic follow-up. Values outside the stated age range require manual review.
